title: 机器人眨灯
style: small yellow retro robot head, enamel metal panels, soft amber LEDs, off-white lab set
beats: A small orange indicator in the cheek lights up
Three tiny antenna lights blink in sequence
The cheek panel opens a few millimeters
A miniature orange bulb peeks out and nods
The bulb retracts and panel closes
All lights return to their original steady state
